name: text-reveal-card
title: Text Reveal Card
blurb: Reveals hidden text by horizontal clip-path under a cursor-tracked gradient…
description: Card that tracks pointer position and animates a clip-path inset to reveal an overlay text. Includes animated star particles in the background. Supports both mouse and touch input.
use_when: Revealing a hidden message or alternative text on hover; creating an interactive reveal effect.
avoid_when: Static designs or devices without pointer input; the component hardcodes dark theme.
a11y: Interaction driven by pointer movement; no keyboard alternative. Focus handling not managed; no prefers-reduced-motion guard.
